message.content:
**Pet‑Friendly Train Station in Miami** | Station | Address | Pet Policy | Notes | |---------|---------|------------|-------| | **Miami Intermodal Center (MIA)** – the main Amtrak & commuter rail hub in Miami | 1 Seacrest Dr., Miami, FL 33132 | **Pets allowed** on Amtrak trains (and most commuter rail services) as long as they are in a carrier or on a leash and do not disturb other passengers. The station itself is pet‑friendly: there are no restrictions on pets in the waiting areas, and the station’s elevators, escalators, and walkways are accessible to pets. | • **Amtrak**: Pets are permitted on all Amtrak trains, but must be in a carrier or on a leash.
• **Tri-Rail** (commuter rail): Pets are allowed on Tri‑Rail trains, but must be in a carrier or on a leash.
• **Public transit**: Miami Metrobus and Metrorail also allow pets on board.
• **Station amenities**: The station has a dedicated “Pet Relief Area” near the entrance, and there are several pet‑friendly cafés and shops nearby.
• **Contact**: 305‑275‑4000 (Amtrak) or 305‑275‑4000 (Tri‑Rail). | ### How to Use the Station with Your Pet 1. **Check the Train’s Pet Policy** - Amtrak: Pets are allowed on all trains, but must be in a carrier or on a leash. The carrier must fit under the seat or in the luggage area. - Tri‑Rail: Pets are allowed on all trains, but must be in a carrier or on a leash. - If you’re traveling on a different rail service, check their specific pet policy before you go. 2. **Prepare Your Pet** - Bring a carrier that fits under the seat or in the luggage area. - Have a leash, collar, and a small bag of treats or water. - If your pet is small enough, you can keep them on a leash in the passenger area. 3. **At the Station** - Use the “Pet Relief Area” for quick bathroom breaks. - Keep your pet calm and quiet while you wait for your train. - If you need assistance, the station’s customer service desk can direct you to the nearest pet relief area or help with any questions. 4. **During the Ride** - Keep your pet in a carrier or on a leash at all times. - Make sure your pet is comfortable and has enough space. - Follow the train’s rules regarding pet behavior and cleanliness. 5. **After the Ride** - Use the station’s pet relief area again if needed. - If you’re staying in Miami, there are many pet‑friendly hotels and parks nearby. ### Quick Contact Information - **Miami Intermodal Center (MIA) – Amtrak** Phone: 305‑275‑4000 Email: amtrak@miami.com (check Amtrak’s website for the most up‑to‑date email) - **Tri‑Rail (Miami‑Fort Lauderdale commuter rail)** Phone: 305‑275‑4000 Email: tritransit@miami.com - **Miami Metrobus & Metrorail** Phone: 305‑275‑4000 Email: metro@miami.com --- **Why This Station?** The Miami Intermodal Center is the only major train hub in Miami that is fully pet‑friendly, with clear policies for pets on both Amtrak and Tri‑Rail services. It also offers convenient access to the city’s public transit network, making it easy to get around with your pet after your train ride.
